title: 第一卷 第3章 圣女大人的新政第一卷 第4章 坏咯玄晶给多了
slug: 人在废丹房从征服师姐开始成仙
content_zh:
;;
“十几亿的生意？”
裴雨嫣古怪地看着他，同时心中感到疑惑。
是自己的错觉吗，怎的感觉这叶云，比起昨日要更年轻了一些？
这时，叶云并未立刻解答，反而笑着问道。
“这待会再说，还是先聊聊师姐你找我何事？”
提及此事，裴雨嫣轻哼一声，淡淡说道。
“并非我，只是奉长老之命，要我到各个杂役部门发布一则通告。”
“是吗？什么通告？”
见叶云一脸疑惑，裴雨嫣的脸上，倒流露出几分幸灾乐祸之色。
“就在昨日，圣女大人决定推动杂役年轻化改革。”
“凡进入圣地二十年，还未通过外门弟子考核者，将会被踢出古道圣地。”
“此项规定，即日生效。”
听完裴雨嫣的讲述，叶云嘴角抽动了一下。
“艹，圣女她的脑子有坑吧？”
所谓外门弟子考核每年都有一次，需要战胜实力在圣地末尾的外门弟子。
可但凡能成杂役的弟子，普遍修炼天赋极差，即使跟吊车尾外门弟子，也都差了十万八千里。
更要命的是，今年的外门弟子考核，就在五天之后。
如果是之前他倒无所谓，反正都要退休，可现在有造化神炉，他说什么都不能被赶出废丹房！
虽然心中已经问候起圣女，但他暗下决心，一定要通过这次的外门弟子考核！

就是死，自己也要死在这废丹房里！
这时，裴雨嫣瞥了他一眼，语气中略带嘲讽。
“总而言之，以你凝气一重的修为，还是趁早收拾行李准备下山吧。”
毕竟负责进行考核的外门弟子，修为普遍在凝气五重，乃至凝气六重之境。
再加上都有玄技与法宝，在战力上，根本不是叶云这等凝气一重的杂役能碰瓷的。
“行吧，我知道了。”
叶云点了下头，心中已有打算。
见此，裴雨嫣轻哼一声道。
“所以，你刚刚说的生意是何意？”
提及这一点，便见叶云悄悄走上前来，双手又在她身上不太老实，这意思十分明显。
“你说，是什么生意？”
裴雨嫣娇躯一颤，旋即瞪了他一眼道。
“叶云，你别太过分！”
话音落下，她就将叶云给一把推开，力气之大，差点没把他给轰飞出去。
作为只差一步，就能从凝气晋级先天的修士，她的实力在外门弟子中也算颇为厉害了。

"A billion-dollar business?"
Pei Yuyan looked at him strangely, feeling confused at the same time.
Is it my own illusion? Why do I feel that Ye Yun is younger than yesterday?
At this time, Ye Yun did not answer immediately, but asked with a smile.
"We'll talk about it later, but let's talk about it first, senior sister, what do you want from me?"
Mentioning this matter, Pei Yuyan snorted and said lightly.
"It's not me. I was just ordered by the elders to go to various miscellaneous departments to make an announcement."
"Really? What announcement?"
Seeing Ye Yun's confused look, Pei Yuyan's face showed a bit of gloating.
"Just yesterday, the Holy Lady decided to promote the reform of rejuvenating the handymen."
"Anyone who has entered the Holy Land for twenty years and has not passed the examination as an outer disciple will be kicked out of the Holy Land."
"This regulation takes effect immediately."
After listening to Pei Yuyan's story, the corner of Ye Yun's mouth twitched.
"Fuck, is there something wrong with the saint's brain?"
The so-called outer sect disciples' assessment takes place once a year, and they need to defeat the outer sect disciples whose strength is at the bottom of the Holy Land.
But all the disciples who can become handymen generally have very poor cultivation talent. Even the disciples from the outer sect at the end of the crane are far behind.
What's even more terrible is that this year's outer disciple examination will be held in just five days.
It wouldn't have mattered to him before, he would have retired anyway, but now that there is the Divine Furnace of Creation, he can't be kicked out of the Wasted Alchemy Room no matter what!
Although he had already greeted the Saint in his heart, he was secretly determined to pass this outer disciple examination!
Even if I die, I will die in this useless alchemy room!
At this time, Pei Yuyan glanced at him with a hint of ridicule in her tone.
"All in all, with your Qi Condensation Level 1 cultivation, you'd better pack your bags and prepare to go down the mountain as soon as possible."
After all, the outer disciples responsible for conducting the assessment are generally at the fifth level of Qi Condensation, or even the sixth level of Qi Condensation.
In addition, they all have mysterious skills and magic weapons. In terms of combat power, there is no way that a handyman like Ye Yun, who is in the first level of Qi Condensation, can compete with him.
"Okay, I get it."
Ye Yun nodded, already having a plan in mind.
Seeing this, Pei Yuyan snorted softly.
"So, what did you mean by business just now?"
When she mentioned this, she saw Ye Yun quietly walking forward, his hands not being very gentle on her body, which was very obvious.
"Tell me, what kind of business is this?"
Pei Yuyan's delicate body trembled, and she immediately glared at him.
"Ye Yun, don't go too far!"
As soon as she finished speaking, she pushed Ye Yun away with such force that she almost blew him away.
As a monk who is only one step away from being able to advance from Qi Condensation to Xiantian, her strength is considered quite powerful among the outer disciples.
